source_sheet.crop: x=(frame%4)*362; y=floor(frame/4)*271; 362x271; row-major. Bottom 2 source pixels outside grid.

motion_references.role: observed walk biomechanics; timing interpreted for draft, not frame-exact motion capture
existing documented motion reference; play/start/landing support

construction: Imagegen generated 16 articulated poses; FFmpeg cropped fixed cells and assembled GIF. No horizontal mirroring. Not mesh-warped standing image.
review_required: right foreleg laterality in every frame
left foreleg absent to shoulder; no stump
both hindlegs visible; no extra fragments
ear shape and forward one-third fold preserved
known_limitations: Scale/proportion and paw-placement variation between generated frames
First loop is an interpretation of observed phases, not a validated exact gait reconstruction
